title: Compositing
text: Combine two images or apply mask to image, 5 inputs, 1 output, {Operation} sets operation; {Opacity factor(s) source} sets the source of opacity factor Specify via, {Opacity factor(s)}, {Location source} sets the source of overlay location Specify via, {Location [x y]} sets the overlay location index, {Mask source} sets the source of mask Specify and {Mask} sets the binary mask. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Operation
params.values: Specify operation Blend (default) | Binary mask | Highlight selected pixels

params.name: Opacity factor(s) source
params.values: Source of opacity factor Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Location source
params.values: Source of overlay location Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Mask source
params.values: Source of mask Specify via dialog (default) | Input port
